```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

`read_agau_prices()` reads the current official HTML table and 33 accessible
chart observations, an exact dated PDF or Word report, the complete table
history, or local official HTML, PDF, Word, text-extract and quarterly ZIP
snapshots.

```{r}
library(readagau)

list_agau_releases("weekly_commodity_prices")

latest <- read_agau_prices(snapshot = "latest")

exact <- read_agau_prices(snapshot = "weekly-prices-2016-10-13")

selected <- read_agau_prices(
  snapshot = "all",
  series = c("A2", "A14", "H1"),
  measures = c("latest_price", "annual_change"),
  from = "2020-01-01"
)
```

The complete-table history contains 475 verified snapshots from 13 October
2016 through 23 July 2026. Each table row retains the published week-average
date, snapshot date, source provider, unit, raw value, parsed value, source
hash and parser version. Current charts add all A1–A25 and H1–H8 observations
using the exact value and observation date in the official accessible image
description.
